biography:
I'm Alvin Xiao, a software engineer and program manager with over 10 years of experience building technology and solving complex problems. Throughout my career, I've had the opportunity to work with first responders, all branches of the U.S. military, and NASA.

One of my favorite parts of my job has always been taking complex problems and breaking them down into something people can actually understand. I love teaching, sharing what I've learned, and helping people figure things out. On the flip side, one of my biggest frustrations is when people make things sound more complicated than they need to be. Technology should make our lives easier, not leave us feeling like we need a technical degree just to understand it.

I think AI is a perfect example of this. There's so much excitement around it, but also a lot of jargon, hype, and conflicting information. It's easy to get the impression that you need to be a programmer or an AI expert to make use of it. The reality is that there are plenty of practical ways AI can help with everyday work, whether that's saving time on repetitive tasks, organizing information, or making it easier to get things done.

That's what got me interested in helping small businesses explore AI and automation. I'm not here to convince everyone they need AI for everything. I want to help people understand what's available, figure out what might actually be useful for them, and feel comfortable trying it out. Sometimes the best solution is surprisingly simple, and sometimes AI isn't the right solution at all.
